title: Fair Prosecution and Anti Selective Enforcement Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal establishing an independent Directorate of Prosecution, pre-arrest judicial scrutiny for politically sensitive arrests, annual anti-vendetta comparator audits, and compensation for malicious prosecution.
notes: Matter 020: Fair Prosecution and Anti Selective Enforcement Bill, 2026.
